applicationProfileDefinition.en: Information that allows to refer in a structured and unique way to a building unit, a berth, a pitch or a plot based on a municipality name, a street name, a house number and possibly a bus number and a postal code.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: The definition refers to Belgian addresses. In other countries, an address may refer to other geographical objects (not a building unit or plot) or consist of other designations (different from house number and box number) or of components other than street name, municipality name or postal code. Alternative address designations than house number or bus number (e.g. entrance indication, staircase indication, floor indication, etc.) or a building name or room name, etc., are possible by means of an association with address expansion. Exchange of foreign addresses must be done using the object address representation.
